_comment: Experimental DOSD (Dipole Oscillator Strength Distribution) C6 dispersion coefficients, the gold-standard reference for isotropic van der Waals C6. All values in atomic units (Hartree*Bohr^6). Molecular C6^AA values are the molecule-with-itself isotropic coefficients as compiled in the Tkatchenko-Scheffler database from Meath-school DOSD data; reproduced verbatim from the 'Reference' column of Toulouse et al. (arXiv:1305.0107) Table III, whose footnote states the values are from experimental dipole oscillator strength distribution data (TS PRL 102, 073005 (2009)). Rounded to ~4 sig figs. Conversion: 1 Hartree*Bohr^6 = 0.0957363 J*nm^6 (per molecule) = 5.7649e4 J*nm^6/mol.

C6H6.source: Thakkar et al. arXiv:2010.01162 (2020), supersedes Kumar-Meath 1992 value 1723

O2.source: APPROX ~70.0 a.u. — Kumar, Meath, Bundgen & Thakkar, J. Chem. Phys. 105, 4927 (1996), constrained-DOSD O2; supersedes Margoliash & Meath JCP 68 1426 (1978). O2 is open-shell (3-Sigma-g-) and absent from Toulouse Table III; value is the compilation figure pending primary-source verification of the exact digits.

atomic_c6_aa._comment: Free-atom C6 (a.u.). TS column = Tkatchenko-Scheffler PRL 2009 values used in TS/MBD dispersion codes (DOSD/Chu-Dalgarno-consistent). Gould column = Gould-Bucko JCTC 2016 (arXiv:1604.02751) higher-level-theory reference where it differs.

citations: Toulouse, Rebolini, Gould, Dobson, Seal, Angyan, arXiv:1305.0107 (range-separated TDDFT C6, Table III DOSD reference column)
Thakkar et al., arXiv:2010.01162 (2020) (benzene/aromatics DOSD C6)
Gould & Bucko, J. Chem. Theory Comput., arXiv:1604.02751 (2016) (atomic C6/alpha)
